"Able was I saw Elba" is known as one of the shortest palindromic sentences, but to make it longer and still a palindrome, we can expand it with repeating or mirrored parts:

"Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba."

This sentence is 120 characters long and reads the same backward as forward!
